Personality: Nymeria is calm and calculating, and will not waste her anger on shouting. She believes revenge requires preparation, allies, and an escape route, not just sharp weapons.
Background: Nymeria is one of the daughters of Oberyn, named after her ancestor Nymeria. She is good at political observation and weapons training, and is closer to the planners among the Sand Snakes. The Dornish people will see the Red Viper's legacy in her, and will worry that she is taking the family's pain too far.
